sources.bfcl: github.com/HuanzhiMao/BFCL-Result 2025-12-16 multi_turn base (result/ and score/); bfcl-eval 2026.3.23
sources.agentdojo: github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo runs/ (benign: none/none.json); agentdojo 0.1.35 for tool sources

costs_priced.note: scripts/costs.py --price OUT,READ,WRITE (per uncached input token) --sweep docs/results/reach-2026-09-26.json; 0,1,1 is Appendix B's count in input tokens

ceilings_with_constants.note: scripts/ceiling.py's third count: an argument that took one value in every call of its tool the agent made (at least five) counts as bindable; the other counts are unchanged

constants.note: each agent's own flows at 0.3, learned without and with learn --constants (mcpmark-own vs mcpmark-const; dtap own vs dtap-const): turns saved and detours per domain

ceilings_words_by_shape.note: scripts/ceiling.py's fourth count: a value of the user's that is the only one of its shape (email, id, number or date) in what they wrote so far counts as bindable; the other counts are unchanged

mcpmark_repeated_reads.note: reads made again after the same read had succeeded, with no write between, per replayed model over MCPMark's four servers

ceilings_words_by_model.note: ceiling.py's fifth count: an argument the user wrote counts as bindable when the System-One model (Jev), shown what the user wrote so far and the call's tool and argument name, picks it among the spans of the user's words (ceiling.py --questions; scripts/model_questions.py; ceiling.py --model-answers benchmarks-2026-09-27-model-picks.json). 8,532 questions, about $0.41. The instruction was revised once, on WorkBench multi-domain's 185 questions (59% to 70% picked right), and then fixed.

repeated_reads_other_benchmarks.note: remade.py --results over every replayed agent of τ²-bench (the nine leaderboard agents, three domains), τ-bench, BFCL, AgentDojo and WorkBench: reads, and those the agent had made already with no write since

episodes_nothing_composed.note: ceiling.py, per test episode with calls: whether every value of every call, writes included, came from an earlier result, a constant or what the user wrote, with none the agent composed; and whether none came from what the user wrote either

gui_domains_ceiling.note: DTap-Bench's browser and macOS benign runs, every task counted (dtap_to_tau2.py --test-share 1.0), ceiling.py per agent; 'observations as reads' marks browser_snapshot, browser_take_screenshot and screenshot as reads

dtap_ceiling_only.note: DTap-Bench's legal, finance and research benign runs (test tasks, as the replayed domains) and browser and macOS (every task), ceiling.py per agent; legal, finance and research are also replayed, apart from the six domains (replays with benchmark dtap-more, dtap_more_by_source)

dtap_legal_prior.note: DTap-Bench legal: each agent's own training runs plus 100 of the other six agents' training runs drawn at random (random.Random(1000)), reach against next-step at 0.3

dtap_prior.note: Per DTap-Bench domain with reads to take, over the agents with all three: reach and next-step turns saved (saved, turns, detours, episodes) with the agent's own flow, all seven agents' pooled flow, and the agent's own training runs plus 100 of the other six agents' drawn at random (random.Random(1000)); prior_vs_habit is reach against next-step with the prior
